pitches: I've got {cargo} sitting on my dock and a buyer in {to} who keeps asking where it is.
Nothing clever about this one: {cargo} from {from} to {to}, handled like you mean it.
You look like a crew that shows up where they say they will. I need that for {to}.
My usual hauler went quiet a week ago. I'd rather not find out why the hard way.
It's {cargo} for {to}. Keep it dry, keep it upright, and we'll get along fine.
Three lanes meet here and every one of them is running late. Yours doesn't have to be.
I've had this manifest on my screen all shift. Take it off my hands?
The ore haulers won't touch anything that isn't ore. You're not an ore hauler.
Packed it myself. If it arrives in {to} the way it left here, I'll remember your ship.
This lot was picked this morning. It won't wait for the next quiet ship.
We grow it slow out here. Getting it to {to} is the part we can't do ourselves.
